Item 2.02
Results of Operations and Financial Condition
The information in this Current Report on Form 8-K, including the exhibits attached hereto, shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities under that Section.  Furthermore, such information, including the exhibits attached hereto, shall not be deemed to be incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
On November 5, 2026, The Southern Company (“Southern Company”) issued a press release regarding its earnings for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, including certain additional information regarding the financial results for such periods.  A copy of this release is being furnished as Exhibit 99 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures
Exhibit 99 to this Current Report on Form 8-K includes earnings and earnings per share in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”) for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026 and 2025.  The exhibit also includes earnings and earnings per share (1) for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, excluding accelerated depreciation and decommissioning costs related to the repowering of certain wind facilities at Southern Power Company, (2) for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026 and the nine-month period ended September 30, 2025, excluding costs associated with the extinguishment of debt at Southern Company, (3) for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, excluding an estimated loss at Southern Company Gas related to costs associated with Nicor Gas capital investments disallowed by the Illinois Commerce Commission, (4) for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026 and the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2025, excluding charges (net of salvage proceeds) and credits, associated legal expenses (net of insurance recoveries), and tax impacts related to plants under construction, (5) for the nine-month period 
ended September 30, 2026, excluding an income tax refund and related contingency fee expenses at Southern Company Gas, and (6) for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2025, excluding disposition impacts related to the sale of a multi-use commercial facility development at Alabama Power Company.  The attached exhibit includes additional information regarding these excluded items, as well as reconciliations of each non-GAAP financial measure to the most comparable financial measure under GAAP.  Southern Company believes the presentation of earnings and earnings per share, excluding these items, is useful to investors because it provides investors with additional information to evaluate the performance of Southern Company’s ongoing business activities.  Southern Company management also uses earnings and earnings per share, excluding the effect of these items, to evaluate the performance of Southern Company’s ongoing business activities.  The presentation of this additional information is not meant to be considered a substitute for financial measures prepared in accordance with GAAP.
Exhibits
Exhibit 99 contains business segment information for Alabama Power Company, Georgia Power Company, Mississippi Power Company, Southern Power Company and Southern Company Gas.  Accordingly, this report is also being furnished on behalf of each such registrant.

November 5, 2026
Southern Company reports third-quarter 2026 earnings
ATLANTA – Southern Company today reported third-quarter earnings of $2.0 billion, or $1.77 per share, in 2026 compared with earnings of $1.7 billion, or $1.55 per share, in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, Southern Company reported earnings of $4.6 billion, or $4.02 per share, compared with $3.9 billion, or $3.56 per share, for the same period in 2025.
Excluding the items described under “Net Income – Excluding Items” in the table below, Southern Company earned $2.2 billion, or $1.94 per share, during the third quarter of 2026, compared with $1.8 billion, or $1.60 per share, during the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, excluding these items, Southern Company earned $5.0 billion, or $4.40 per share, compared with $4.1 billion, or $3.76 per share, for the same period in 2025.

Adjusted earnings drivers for the third quarter of 2026, as compared with the same period in 2025, were warmer weather, increased usage and customer growth, growing revenue from large commercial and industrial customers along with higher earnings from Southern Power, partially offset by higher non-fuel 
Page 2
operating expenses and taxes other than income taxes, along with dilution impacts from additional shares outstanding.
Third-quarter 2026 operating revenues were $8.8 billion, compared with $7.8 billion for the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 13.0%. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, operating revenues were $24.2 billion, compared with $22.6 billion for the corresponding period in 2025, an increase of 7.3%.
“The Southeast is growing at a pace that is both unprecedented and transformational, and we believe Southern Company is well positioned for today and in the future,” said Chris Womack, chairman, president and CEO of Southern Company. “Our scale, our experience and our customer-focused strategy allow us to serve this growing demand in a responsible and sustainable manner, with the same discipline, credibility and customer focus that have long defined our company. We know how important reliable energy is to our customers and take great pride in improving the communities and states we are privileged to serve.”
Southern Company’s third-quarter earnings slides with supplemental financial information are available at 
investor.southerncompany.com
.
Southern Company’s financial analyst call will begin at 1 p.m. Eastern Time today, during which Womack and Chief Financial Officer David P. Poroch will discuss earnings and provide a general business update. Investors, media and the public may listen to a live webcast of the call and view associated slides at 
investor.southerncompany.com
. A replay of the webcast will be available on the site for 12 months.
About Southern Company
Southern Company (NYSE: SO) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success, driven by our nearly 30,000 employees dedicated to delivering exceptional service. To learn more, visit 
www.southerncompany.com
.

Dilution is not material in any period presented. Diluted earnings per share was $1.76 and $4.00 for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, and $1.54 and $3.54 for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively.
(2)
Earnings include pre-tax charges of $118 million ($92 million after tax) and $414 million ($322 million after tax) for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, and $103 million ($80 million after tax, net of noncontrolling interest impacts) and $168 million ($130 million after tax, net of noncontrolling interest impacts) for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, associated with accelerated depreciation and decommissioning costs related to the repowering of certain wind facilities at Southern Power Company. Accelerated depreciation and decommissioning costs associated with the replacement of equipment will continue until the completion dates of the repowering projects, which are projected to occur through the third quarter 2027. At September 30, 2026, the remaining pre-tax accelerated depreciation and decommissioning costs are projected to total approximately $100 million in 2026 and $135 million in 2027.
(3)
Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 include costs associated with the extinguishment of debt at Southern Company totaling $43 million ($40 million after tax) and $54 million ($49 million after tax), respectively, as a result of Southern Company's repurchase of certain convertible senior notes and redemption of certain junior subordinated notes. Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 also include $57 million associated with a change in tax benefits related to the extinguishment of debt in 2025. Earnings for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 include costs associated with extinguishment of debt at Southern Company totaling $129 million ($97 million after tax) as a result of Southern Company's repurchase of certain convertible senior notes. Similar transaction costs may occur in the future at Southern Company or one of its unregulated subsidiaries; however, the amount and timing of any such costs are uncertain.
(4)
Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 include an estimated loss of $9 million ($7 million after tax) and $19 million ($14 million after tax), respectively, at Southern Company Gas related to costs associated with Nicor Gas capital investments disallowed by the Illinois Commerce Commission in November 2025. Further charges may occur; however, the amount and timing of any such charges are uncertain.
(5)
Earnings include income tax charges of $4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 related to the remeasuring of deferred tax assets associated with the previously recognized estimated probable loss on Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4 due to changes in the State of Georgia corporate tax rate. Additionally, earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 include pre-tax credits to income of $33 million ($25 million after tax) related to the estimated probable loss on Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4 reflecting revisions to Georgia Power Company's total project capital cost forecast resulting from reductions in remaining expected site demobilization costs and other contractor obligations. Site demobilization efforts were completed during the third quarter 2025. Further charges and/or credits may occur; however, the amount and timing are uncertain. Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 also include charges (net of salvage proceeds), associated legal expenses (net of insurance recoveries), and tax impacts related to Mississippi Power Company's integrated coal gasification combined cycle facility project in Kemper County, Mississippi. Dismantlement of the abandoned gasifier-related assets was completed at the end of 2025. Site restoration activities are substantially complete, and any additional costs are expected to be immaterial.
(6)
Earnings for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 include a state income tax refund of $9 million ($7 million after federal tax) at Southern Company Gas associated with the 2018 disposition of Elizabethtown Gas, partially offset by related contingency fee expenses of $2 million ($1 million after tax) incurred in connection with obtaining the refund. Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 include a pre-tax gain of $2 million ($1 million after tax) related to the sale of a multi-use commercial facility development at Alabama Power Company. Further impacts may result from past and future disposition activities; however, the amount and timing of any such impacts are uncertain.

Accelerated depreciation and decommissioning costs associated with the replacement of equipment will continue until the completion dates of the repowering projects, which are projected to occur through the third quarter 2027. At September 30, 2026, the remaining pre-tax accelerated depreciation and decommissioning costs are projected to total approximately $100 million in 2026 and $135 million in 2027.
(3)
Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 include costs associated with the extinguishment of debt at Southern Company totaling $43 million ($40 million after tax) and $54 million ($49 million after tax), respectively, as a result of Southern Company's repurchase of certain convertible senior notes and redemption of certain junior subordinated notes. Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 also include $57 million associated with a change in tax benefits related to the extinguishment of debt in 2025. Earnings for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 include costs associated with extinguishment of debt at Southern Company totaling $129 million ($97 million after tax) as a result of Southern Company's repurchase of certain convertible senior notes. Similar transaction costs may occur in the future at Southern Company or one of its unregulated subsidiaries; however, the amount and timing of any such costs are uncertain.
(4)
Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 include an estimated loss of $9 million ($7 million after tax) and $19 million ($14 million after tax), respectively, at Southern Company Gas related to costs associated with Nicor Gas capital investments disallowed by the Illinois Commerce Commission in November 2025. Further charges may occur; however, the amount and timing of any such charges are uncertain.
(5)
Earnings include income tax charges of $4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 related to the remeasuring of deferred tax assets associated with the previously recognized estimated probable loss on Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4 due to changes in the State of Georgia corporate tax rate. Additionally, earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 include pre-tax credits to income of $33 million ($25 million after tax) related to the estimated probable loss on Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4 reflecting revisions to Georgia Power Company's total project capital cost forecast resulting from reductions in remaining expected site demobilization costs and other contractor obligations. Site demobilization efforts were completed during the third quarter 2025. Further charges and/or credits may occur; however, the amount and timing are uncertain. Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 also include charges (net of salvage proceeds), associated legal expenses (net of insurance recoveries), and tax impacts related to Mississippi Power Company's integrated coal gasification combined cycle facility project in Kemper County, Mississippi. Dismantlement of the abandoned gasifier-related assets was completed at the end of 2025. Site restoration activities are substantially complete, and any additional costs are expected to be immaterial.
(6)
Earnings for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 include a state income tax refund of $9 million ($7 million after federal tax) at Southern Company Gas associated with the 2018 disposition of Elizabethtown Gas, partially offset by related contingency fee expenses of $2 million ($1 million after tax) incurred in connection with obtaining the refund. Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 include a pre-tax gain of $2 million ($1 million after tax) related to the sale of a multi-use commercial facility development at Alabama Power Company. Further impacts may result from past and future disposition activities; however, the amount and timing of any such impacts are uncertain.
